candidates.title: GrowthBook 5.2: Interleaving experiments and Human in the Loop for agents
candidates.summary: GrowthBook 5.2 adds interleaving experiments, Human in the Loop for agents, remote saved groups, and redesigned experiment and metric flows.

candidates.title: Interleaving Experiments: How to Test Rankers Faster
candidates.summary: Learn how interleaving experiments compare ranking algorithms with a fraction of the traffic an A/B test needs, with examples from Netflix, Airbnb and DoorDash.

candidates.title: How Preply runs 1,000 tests a year
candidates.summary: Sebastien Polis explains how Preply runs close to 1,000 experiments a year, why losing tests are expected, and how a two-sided marketplace changes the stats.

candidates.title: Why Product and Marketing Should Experiment Together to Protect the User Experience
candidates.summary: Product and marketing experimentation works best on one platform. See how shared metrics, guardrails, and holdouts protect the user experience.

candidates.title: Should You Cap Outliers? Winsorization in A/B Testing
candidates.summary: Learn how Winsorization affects bias, variance, and statistical power in A/B tests—and when capping outliers can lead to better experiment decisions.

candidates.title: Why migrate from LaunchDarkly to GrowthBook
candidates.summary: We interviewed teams that migrated from LaunchDarkly to GrowthBook to learn why they switched, what they gained, and lessons for making the most of migration. Discover their insights.
